records.title: VID:DID Dynamic request selects at power-on and clears assignedId at power-off
records.blocker: The product has no Dynamic request schema, runtime assignedId state or power-off clearing path connected to the Static transaction core.

records.title: Subsystem and revision constraints are exact optional Dynamic matches
records.blocker: The selector normalization and exact subsystem/revision matcher are not implemented against the signed compatibility profile.

records.title: Custom labels match exactly and invalid labels return a stable reason
records.blocker: There is no product label catalog, normalized matcher or invalid-label reason contract.

records.title: Candidates sharing one dependency domain deduplicate to one bundle
records.blocker: The Dynamic candidate builder is not implemented on top of authoritative dependency-bundle identity and hash deduplication.

records.title: Selected candidate drives its exact BAR and bridge-window plan
records.blocker: The Dynamic solver and full-tree resource planner are not connected, so heterogeneous candidates do not produce candidate-specific BAR plans.

records.title: Heterogeneous RMRR candidates use one safe envelope or fail with a conflict
records.blocker: The selector-wide reserved-memory envelope and candidate conflict reason are not implemented in the product solver.

records.title: Candidate exhaustion is an all-or-nothing PROFILE_NO_MATCH result
records.blocker: No product solver transaction proves an unsatisfied requirement leaves every candidate and VM definition unchanged.

records.title: Multiple requirements choose a deterministic non-overlapping solution
records.blocker: The global multi-requirement matcher, deterministic tie-break and disjoint-bundle constraint are not implemented.

records.title: Exact search finds a valid assignment that greedy selection misses
records.blocker: The production solver has no bounded backtracking implementation or deterministic greedy-failure fixture.

records.title: Two VMs racing for one bundle produce exactly one CAS winner
records.blocker: Dynamic prepare and reservation are not connected to a product authority that can prove a single winner under concurrent processes.

records.title: Inventory change after prepare invalidates and recomputes the entire solution
records.blocker: The Dynamic reservation path lacks immutable snapshot binding, epoch CAS and full-solution retry after inventory drift.

records.title: Partial Dynamic bind or reset failure rolls back or quarantines every bundle
records.blocker: The Dynamic controller does not reuse a product-complete Static rollback/quarantine core across multiple selected bundles.

records.title: Powered-off relocation resolves a new target-host assignedId
records.blocker: Cross-host capability aggregation and target-side re-solve are not implemented; copying the source BDF is not an acceptable substitute.

records.title: Candidate with an incompatible guest ABI class is excluded
records.blocker: The compatibility catalog and Dynamic selector do not yet compare a versioned guest ABI class for every candidate.

records.title: Functional device group is selected and reserved as one unit
records.blocker: Functional-group discovery, exact qualification and all-member global reservation are not implemented for the product solver.
